reels.title: NeMo-DCR: Bit-Exact Delta-Compressed Refit for Scalable Agentic RL at Trillion-Parameter Scale

editorial_notes.reasoning: This paper addresses a high-stakes hardware efficiency challenge: the massive data-transfer bottleneck during trillion-parameter model training. The 'delta-compression' concept allows for elegant visualizations of only showing the 'changes' between two massive data states rather than the whole, which is highly visual.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: How do you send a one-trillion parameter AI update across a network without the internet crashing?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Instead of sending a massive 500-page book every time you change one word, you only send a tiny sticky note that says 'Page 42, Line 3: change cat to dog'.
